summary.en: During a sleepover at a mountain cabin, Sonoko has been telling Ran a story of Hannya, whom a woman was killed by when she got lost in the woods. The story easily scared the poor girl as she seeks safety from Conan. Conan and Sonoko decide to let Ran cook the dinner while they pick wild vegetables as a way for her to investigate the rumor.

victims.name: Unnamed woman
victims.causeOfDeath: Blood loss caused by stab wound
